constructor_migration: CanonicalPublisher constructor requires exact original private binding on the source-selected native V3 route before writing any capture. Other prior routes remain separately held; no weak V3 constructor fallback. Bind source first, then source-selected publisher may capture native policies/records. No publication of the binding is a prerequisite for its own first publication.

consumer_inverse.CanonicalPublisher.CapturedRecord: unchanged original capture attempt/Store/parent/arm identity and exact write+readback
consumer_inverse.PublicationAckV1.original_capture_source: same binding accessor on actual H publisher that completed write/readback; never profile.storage_source or ConstructionPlan.capture_source
consumer_inverse.WorkerCanonicalPublisher: compare ack to exact private pre-Hello/current policy expected source and actual original pending bytes/site; equal source alone does not create capture
consumer_inverse.WorkerPreHelloDescriptorV3.canonical_pub: same current policy expected source; earlier than first worker publication

earliest_source_owner: The issuer is the actual original source-admission prior_root/qualified static source owner, before _capture_static_chain or any CanonicalPublisher effect. It is not a future Native RootBootstrapAnchor, BootstrapEntryHandle, Context policy, table capture or new publisher receipt. Same original ParentCustody is retained. Source qualification must establish actual loaded implementation; no received dictionary or incomplete future root record supplies it.
failure_cost: Missing/foreign/stale descriptor, actual loaded-source mismatch, unavailable original admission or immutable accessor => before first publisher effect. Original root custody owns failed selection. Source authentication/repeated reads/accessor setup charged to original source/parent plan; no new budget.
preimage_status: Exact selected current source context only, not accepted future patched bytes. Adding accessor/issuer changes actual module bytes; final source admission must pin the complete actual integrated module/import closure. No stale preimage hash is automatically a current selection.
privacy: Wire Pin uses earlier source descriptor logical identity only. No host private path, source body, arbitrary read or source-fetch callback is exposed. Readonly source/native qualification and source-root identity remain required.
private_binding: CanonicalPublisherSourceBindingV3 is registered immutably on that actual earlier prior_root source owner before first publication, retaining source-admission/source-closure/loaded implementation/ParentCustody identities. Later RootBootstrapAdmission/RootBootstrapAnchor and H publishers borrow that same actual binding; no authority duplication and no first-publication cycle.
producer: Actual earlier independently admitted root source closure has exactly one fixed canonical_publisher implementation descriptor and actual source/private issuer relation. Fixed bind_canonical_publisher_source_v3 selects that role and verifies actual loaded module/class/capture source identity before any publisher instance or publication. No generic descriptor list membership or caller supplied field qualifies.
